_format: Themes in menu order, each with its own aircraft; all themes are open from the start. vehicle picks the model, sound and controls, and loads config/<vehicle>.json over config/flight.json (prop, the default, is flight.json alone). levels are flown in order: level 1 is always open, each later one opens once the one before it has been finished. A level's id keys its saved best time, so keep ids unique across all themes and don't rename them; the id and name here override the ones inside the course file. A level may set its own vehicle to override the theme's.
